_why: Lines a post may use word for word to say how SVPay makes money and what is free. Chosen Nov 11, 2026 from the founder's pricing decision (Nov 8: 'Never paid by volume') and www.svpay.app/pricing ('Simple pricing. Never per sale.'; '0% processing fees and $0 to cash out, on every plan.'; Starter free, Growth and Pro paid). The founder asked Claude to choose. They satisfy CR13, CR14, CR34, CO04 and CO06 when used next to the claim. Re-check the prices on www.svpay.app/pricing before quoting any dollar amount. Nov 11 evening: the panel flagged the lines as pasted-in when two of them were used back to back (two '0%' sentences in a row). Use ONE line per post, the one that fits; 'pricing_one_line' is the default. www.svpay.app/pricing states no Growth or Pro prices, no contract length, no cost to leave beyond 'Cancel anytime', and nothing about hardware: never claim those.
rule: Use at most one of these lines in a post, word for word, right next to the claim it qualifies. A post that makes no no-fee, $0, free or pricing claim needs none of them.
pricing_one_line: When customers pay with SVPay instead of a card, the shop pays 0% in processing fees and $0 to cash out; SVPay makes money from paid software plans instead.
how_svpay_makes_money: SVPay makes money from paid software plans, never from a cut of your sales.
pricing_full: Payments made with SVPay have 0% processing fees and $0 to cash out, on every plan. SVPay makes money from paid software plans (Starter is free; Growth and Pro add staff, locations and tools), never from a cut of your sales.
free_calculator: The savings calculator is free to use; SVPay's Growth and Pro plans are paid.
zero_fee_condition: 0% processing fees apply to payments made with SVPay, not to card payments.
